translation: Slightly cold, non-toxic. It chiefly treats vexation and fullness of the heart and abdomen, wilting and withering of the four limbs, sweating, spontaneous fright when lying down at night, anger, hidden qi below the heart, inability to breathe, intestinal abscess, internal carbuncle, and yin erosion; it stops sweating, promotes urination, stops blood in the urine, nourishes the essence and spirit, settles the hun and po, and settles the five viscera.
